lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Refresh regular preterite verbs for talking about yesterday.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Morning small talk about what happened after work yesterday.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Describing completed everyday actions in the past.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik ask each other what they did yesterday after work, using simple regular past-tense verbs.

main_focus.name: regular preterite for completed actions
main_focus.description: Use common regular past-tense forms to describe finished everyday actions.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use regular preterite verbs naturally 5-7 times in the dialogue.

allowed_supporting_grammar: basic modal verbs only if needed

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use familiar regular verbs in short past-tense statements.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker asks what the other did yesterday.
dialogue_shape.middle: They exchange two or three simple completed actions after work.
dialogue_shape.ending: They react briefly and move back to today's workday.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat regular preterite forms in clear, separate clauses

focus: which activity happened in the evening

sentence_focus: one question asking what someone did yesterday
